scope: 97 screenshot/API-evidenced medals: historical owner wall of 94 plus owner-earned shares for Perfect reading weeks 40 and 42 and Raging reading week 41 in 2026. Includes 35 API-confirmed official assets and 62 screenshot-sourced medals. Original icon crops preserved; transparent normalized display derivatives remove only exterior backgrounds. This does not establish current full inventory or future weekly automatic coverage.
image_source: Official WeRead Android 10.2.2.10167650_0.apk: medals.hbc (medalsV4) and readChallenge.hbc (medalsV5)
